To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the porcine EST resource contains polyadenylated transcripts with ncRNA candidates in 1,262 contigs and 40 singletons and that 114 of these contigs with RNA structure candidates are expressed in at least ten non-normalized cDNAs libraries.
we identified known RNA secondary structures in 137 conreads and predicted novel conserved RNA secondary structures in an additional 1,260 conreads.

We have identified known ncRNA structures and conserved RNA structures in polyadenated porcine ESTs, which are in general expressed on a much lower level compared to protein coding transcripts and that the amount of ncRNAs are highest in libraries from developmental (neural) tissues".
In summary, our research is concerned with
ncRNA candidates in the porcine genome.
the identification and characterisation of ncRNAs and their expression patterns in a mammalian species.
the identification of ncRNAs and the prediction of novel RNA secondary structures.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the EST2ncRNA pipeline is a powerful and useful tool to search for novel ncRNAs, which is exemplified in our analysis of the PigEST resource and related mammals.
we have identified a significant number of ncRNAs, which are expressed in a variety of porcine tissues.
the ncRNA candidates in the porcine data are expressed at low levels and that their expression is enriched in cDNA libraries of developmental stages.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the porcine transcriptome is rich in ncRNAs, and that the porcines are a suitable model for ncRNA research.
the PigEST resource contains a significant fraction of polyadenylate ncRNAs, which is in line with previous findings.
the porcine ESTs comprise a significant amount of ncRNAs, which are in general expressed in low amounts.
The main takeaway from our work is that

we have developed a novel pipeline for the detection of RNA structures and we have applied this pipeline to the Sino-Danse pigEST resource and identified a large number of novel putative RNA secondary structures.
EST2ncRNA is a useful tool to predict ncRNA candidates from EST data, and that EST2ncRNAs predictions can be used to guide experimental design for further studies of ncRNAs.
the porcine EST resource contains many polyadenylated RNA structures that are conserved between mammals, and that these structures are expressed at a low level.
